item.name: Chef
item.taskSummary: Prepares customer food orders at nearby order counters.
item.fullCost: 4.7K-21.95K Cash per fully upgraded Chef/Server slot
item.keyUpgrades: Faster chopping, faster frying, +40% walk speed, then faster mixing with +60% walk speed.
item.equipmentUnlock: Needs the same cooking setup as the player: a counter and a stove. Cooking duty can be toggled in Edit Worker.
item.specialPerks: No premium perk listed; improves through cash upgrades and contributes to Leadership milestone progress when hired or upgraded.
item.cardSummary: Chefs automate food preparation. They are the core worker to upgrade when kitchen output is slowing service.

item.name: Server
item.taskSummary: Handles customer service tasks such as greeting customers, taking orders, serving food, and clearing dishes.
item.fullCost: 4.7K-21.95K Cash per fully upgraded Chef/Server slot
item.keyUpgrades: +20% walk speed, Waiter Tray, +60% walk speed, then Waiter Cart.
item.equipmentUnlock: Server tasks can be customized in the Edit Worker menu.
item.specialPerks: No premium perk listed; plate-carrying upgrades make this the main service-flow worker.
item.cardSummary: Servers cover the front-of-house loop. They are useful when orders, dishes, and customer movement are piling up.

item.name: Barista
item.taskSummary: Makes drinks and serves them to customers.
item.fullCost: 2.2K-2.4K Cash per fully upgraded Barista/Operator slot
item.keyUpgrades: +30% walk speed, Waiter Tray, +60% walk speed, then Waiter Cart.
item.equipmentUnlock: Works with drinks; the drinks system is unlocked through the drinks upgrade. Barista tasks can be customized in Edit Worker.
item.specialPerks: Unlocks more drink handling through upgrades and supports drink service once the station is active.
item.cardSummary: Baristas specialize in drink service. Add them when drinks become part of the restaurant loop and normal servers are not enough.

item.name: Operator
item.taskSummary: Works at the Drive-Thru by taking orders, bringing orders, and collecting cash from Level 4 onward.
item.fullCost: 2.2K-2.4K Cash per fully upgraded Barista/Operator slot
item.keyUpgrades: Headset comms, Waiter Tray, Drive-Thru cash collection at Level 4, then +60% walk speed.
item.equipmentUnlock: Built around Drive-Thru automation; operator tasks can be customized in Edit Worker.
item.specialPerks: Can take orders from anywhere after the headset upgrade and can collect Drive-Thru cash from Level 4.
item.cardSummary: Operators automate the Drive-Thru. They matter once the restaurant has a Drive-Thru path and the player wants that flow handled by staff.

item.name: Chip Shop Diva
item.taskSummary: Premium waiter-style Super Staff that helps service customers and boosts specific chip-shop dishes.
item.maxHired: One named Super Staff item verified
item.keyUpgrades: Automatically Level 5 and uses the same upgrade set as its worker type.
item.equipmentUnlock: Requires the Chip Shop Diva Super Staff purchase; tied to the Chippy Diva bundle and fish-and-chips dish boosts.
item.specialPerks: Super speed, 2x tip chance, super boosts to five chip-shop dishes, unique personality, and custom voice lines.
item.cardSummary: Chip Shop Diva is the verified Super Staff entry. Treat her separately from cash workers because she is premium and comes with named bonus perks.
